title: Advances in the bioapplications of ionic pillararenes
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00458B, Review Article
Open Access

Ziyan Shen, Shuang Chao, Luling Wu, Huanyu Liu, Yuxin Pei, Tony D. James, Zhichao Pei
Ionic pillararenes, with their unique ionic properties, have become important tools for solving problems in life sciences and exhibit remarkable potential in fields such as transmembrane transport, bio-sensing, and cancer diagnosis and treatment.
